body:
It is with deepest gratitude that I write to thank you for your writings.  I can’t begin to explain the impact they have had in my heart.  I have wanted to let you know for some time.   Naked Spirituality was my first of your books, I look forward to reading more.

    This year I have been reading Seeking Aliveness each morning, along with the Daily Meditation from CAC .  The richness of the pair has been delicious food for my soul.  Often I journal after the readings and dig in deeper to God’s love.

   So, just thank you.

 With my most sincere gratitude,

 Thanks for these kind words. Especially glad to hear that Seeking Aliveness is offering daily soul-nourishment!
